workflow: academic-research-suite/deep-research fact-check; inline source-verification phase only, primary agent synthesis separate
scope: Selected original mathematical claims and transfers, not a venue-wide novelty search or manuscript review

claims.claim: The new Boolean-head papers directly subsume the continuous affine-curve lemma.
claims.reason: Boolean per-token encoding makes exponentials affine on bits; continuous curve leaves real exponentials. Domain and parameter maps differ. Their normal-form/sign-change strategy is prior art, so a different domain alone does not establish substantive novelty.

claims.claim: A nonlinear positive scoring rule can exceed the log-probability rank of a low-dimensional softmax.
claims.reason: MoS and sigsoftmax already establish nonlinear log-score rank lifting. A Q-RMEA specialization requires additional same-core contribution and task evidence.

claims.claim: Sigsoftmax theorem4 establishes exact inclusion for finite parameters.
claims.reason: Its infinite-shift construction establishes a limit. For S=span{(-1,0,1),1}, strict concavity of g(z)=2z-log(1+exp(z)) prevents any finite nonconstant point from equaling softmax((-1,0,1)); only closure inclusion follows from that argument.

publication_limits: Primary mathematical original sources; only selected proofs checked. Workshop/preprint identity is provenance, not an evidence-quality guarantee. No Lean code or empirical replication.
